name: Family Reunification

qualifying_event.description: Spouses/registered partners (min. age 21) and unmarried minor children (including adopted/step-children) of an Austrian citizen, an EU Blue Card/Red-White-Red Card holder, a researcher, or a Settlement Permit holder may apply to join the sponsor. Permit type and quota exposure depend on the sponsor's status.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Proof of family relationship (marriage/partnership/birth certificate); sponsor's status documents; income, insurance, and housing evidence.

requirements.blocker_text: Spouses/registered partners must be at least 21 years old; unmarried minor children (including adopted/step-children) also qualify; certain dependent relatives may qualify with a sponsor's liability declaration.
Sponsor must show fixed and regular income enabling the family to meet its livelihood without welfare -- at least EUR 1,273.99/month (2025 single rate).
Health insurance covering all risks in Austria is required.
Legal accommodation meeting local size/standard norms is required (lease or ownership documentation).
A1-level German from a recognized institution is required before the visa is issued, with exemptions for minors under 14, researchers' families, and refugees' families.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain an A1 German certificate from a recognized provider (e.g. Goethe-Institut, OeSD).

evidence_required.document: Sponsor's income, insurance, and housing evidence

outcome.duration_length: varies by sponsor category (Red-White-Red Card Plus, Family Member permit, Settlement Permit, or Settlement Permit -- Dependent)

sources.title: migration.gv.at -- Family reunification: qualifying relatives, income/insurance/housing/A1-German requirements, 4 permit sub-types by sponsor status, quota rules, fees (EUR 100 + EUR 20)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Austria). work_rights modeled 'restricted' since two of the four sub-permit types (Settlement Permit and Settlement Permit -- Dependent) carry work restrictions (self-employment only, or none) -- only Family Member (relatives of Austrian citizens) and Red-White-Red Card Plus grant unrestricted work. No quotas apply for family of Red-White-Red Card/EU Blue Card holders, Austrian citizens, or researchers; other sponsor categories face annual numeric limits, not modeled as a hard requirement here since the applicant does not control this.
